## Goals of this notebook

The steps we'll take to prepare our data:

- Download the data
- Import it into our notebook
- Clean up data types and columns
- Export the data for next notebook

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
```

## Import cleaned data

```{r}
read_rds("data-processed/01-cleaning.rds")
```

## Show the change in enrollment

```{r}
enrollment_change <- removal_enrollment |>
   mutate(
    special_education_change = (
      ((x2026_2027 - x2025_2026) / x2025_2026) * 100
    ) |> round_half_up(1)
  ) |> 
  arrange(desc(special_education_change))

enrollment_change
```
